expectedBeats.text: Team, we found it! The prototype attachments are here, but... they're all in separate pieces?
Decker, do you know anything about this?
They're meant to bind to your ship as you begin to fly off into space.
The Federation has been having me work on this binding technology. The pieces attach to your aircraft during ascent.
The airbase caught another uplink. Look at what attacked that dish.
And whatever attacked that dish is still hacking our networks!
Then we have no choice. One of us will have to go straight for it and get to the bottom of this.
Well, whoever decides to go, just let the team know the kit is ready. Awaiting your orders, sir!
Team, the kit is ready. One last check, then I'm going up.
